name: Streamystats Integration
description: Jellyfin 12 integration with dashboard setup, per-user visibility, health checks, secure session switching and reverse-proxy guidance.
overview: Embeds Streamystats as a responsive Jellyfin 12 Web view.

versions.changelog:
Initial Jellyfin 12 release.

- Guided setup directly in the Jellyfin dashboard.
- Modern and Legacy Web navigation with responsive embedded Streamystats.
- Per-user visibility and fail-closed Streamystats session switching.
- Nginx, Nginx Proxy Manager, Caddy and Traefik guidance.
